summary: Broad non-P0 source swarm repaired a hard TalkBack/detail projection budget, corrected its own first regression fixture, synchronized durable doctrine, performed evidence reviews, and preserved a separate next source-truth wound without touching the gated phone/P0 chain.

frontsAdvanced.change: HeartbeatInvisibleSemanticControlPolicy now counts the complete truncation indicator inside the caller's hard code-point budget and preserves atomic marker/backslash projection units.

HeartbeatEvidenceDetailProjectionTest now pins suffix reservation, total returned bounds, tiny-budget behavior, existing invisible-marker visibility, and exact scene-source preservation; source review corrected an initially false two-marker fixture.
heartbeat-invisible-semantic-controls now encodes the hard returned-budget law and regression requirements, preventing `budget + suffix` from becoming canon again.
Durable receipts preserve the plan-target pivot, corrected fixture, exact source identities, Actions-budget boundary, capability membrane, and bounded STOP/CONTINUE verdicts.

Verified that HeartbeatSkillPolicy.detailContentDescription(Candidate) remains an independent typed-detail formatter while scene consumers use HeartbeatEvidenceDetailProjection; preserved as a separate non-P0 finding, not mixed into this repair.

crossPollination: One-detail-authority archaeology exposed the old bounded projection implementation closely enough to reveal the unbudgeted suffix defect.
Accessibility turned that defect from cosmetic wording into a hard resource/speech contract.
Regnet-style review then caught the first regression fixture failing to trigger its intended code path, forcing a second source correction.
Durable skill doctrine absorbed both scars while evidence discipline kept canonical source/checkpoint identity unchanged.
The unchanged P0 firewall forced the swarm to produce useful repository work without borrowing the shared phone surface.
